title: Senior Technical Trainer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 Our Training Team delivers world\-class technical training for Qualys IT security risk and compliance solutions in the classroom and online. We are a global team of training professionals passionate about helping customers learn and succeed with our products. We're looking for an experienced Technical Trainer to join us!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Consult with stakeholders to define technical enablement needs; this is a shared responsibility within the training team.
* Work with multiple teams, including Engineering, Product Management, SME, Sales, and Support, to consolidate knowledge elements, review, validate, and ensure training content aligns with business requirements.
* Manage and deliver technical training to our customers, prospects, partners, and internal Qualys employees, in\-person or via virtual mediums.
* Collaborate with team members to design, develop, maintain and deliver exceptional technical training materials in multiple modalities, including eLearning, videos, simulations, labs, and instructor\-led classroom training.
* Independently design, build, and deliver training courses and associated training aids like videos, simulations and lab guides.
* Be an advocate for Qualys Products and contribute to the success of our training programs.
* Conduct peer reviews for existing content development activities.
* Assist Leads on Training Projects.
* Develop your skills to become a subject matter expert on flagship products you create and deliver training for and address various knowledge needs for the support organization with the prime responsibility of training customers and employees.
* Assist in designing, building, and maintaining virtual lab environments and associated lab guides to support technical training courses.
* Manage functions in the Learning Management System relevant to your job duties.


**Essential**
**Skills and Experience**
* BSc/MSc degree or equivalent experience in computer science or related engineering fields.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in delivering technical training, both in\-person and remotely.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience with Cyber Security products or platforms, such as but not limited to Endpoint Security, Vulnerability Management, SIEM (Security Information and Event Management), Network Security, Firewall, UTMs, Compliance solutions, etc.
* Must have previous experience in designing and developing materials and writing assessments for technical training.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
* Ability to execute several parallel tasks and prioritize appropriately.
* Ability to adapt to recent technologies and learn quickly.
* Must be based in Pune, IN.
* Must be open to travel independently for onsite training delivery.
* Must be experienced in working across multiple geographic regions when required.


**Desirable**
* Knowledge and experience of using Qualys products.
* Experience with delivering Certification\-based Training as part of an education program.
* Experience with Video content and Simulation creation tools like Adobe Premiere, Screenflow, Camtasia, Captivate.
* Understanding of compliance standards and frameworks such as PCI, CIS, NIST, etc.
* Knowledge of any one of the Public Cloud Platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experienced in creating/modifying custom scripts.
* Experienced in building complex virtual environments.
* Experience with Adult learning theory.
* Experience with instructional design models.
* CompTIA Security \+, ISC2 CC and Cloud Platform Certifications are a strong plus.


 A technical presentation will be required during the interview process. References of sample videos and training materials created by the candidate will be a plus.

title: Product Operations Specialist-2
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Product Operations Specialist\-2
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.
   

  

 As a company, we know that our success is driven by the skills, experience, integrity and mindset of the talent we hire. By building an inclusive, world\-class culture, our employees have once\-in\-a\-career opportunities to be part of teams that have a greater impact on our community and our world. We invite you to join our team to find out how you too can start something priceless.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Customer Communication Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring that Mastercard’s Cross\-Border Services Customers receive timely, accurate, and actionable information. This role bridges the gap between technical operations and customer\-facing communication, helping to streamline the process, ensure accuracy, provide high quality information, and enhance the overall customer experience.
   

  

**Role**
* Participate in a non\-standard work week Monday – Friday, one position working an early morning shift.
* Ensure a good customer experience for both external customers and internal stakeholders.
* Develop and manage internal and external communications related to product updates, service changes, and operational enhancements.
* Collaborate with product, technical, and regional teams to ensure alignment and readiness for customer\-facing communications.
* Monitor shared mailboxes and ticketing systems (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud) to triage and escalate customer inquiries.
* Draft, review, and publish customer communications in accordance with governance workflows and compliance standards.
* Track and analyze customer feedback to improve communication quality, frequency, and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate documentation of communications, communication processes and procedures.
* Support the archiving and lifecycle management of customer\-facing content.


**All About You**
* Able to understand Cross\-Border Services business with a solid understanding of the transaction processing flow.
* Able to prioritize, manage, and organize multiple tasks concurrently while meeting deadlines.
* Able to identify critical and priority issues, and proactively reprioritize daily tasks as needed.
* Self\-motivated individual who works successfully, ethically, and cooperatively in a team atmosphere.
* Demonstrates exceptional written and verbal communication skills (in English), with the ability to understand and reframe content into customer\-friendly language.


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of experience in customer support, communications, or operations within the financial services or technology sector.
* Capable of proof\-reading and editing documents.
* Demonstrated strong attention to detail and organization.
* Experience working in a global, cross\-functional environment.
* Familiarity with APIs and ability to interpret payload data is a plus.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams is required.
* Proficiency in tools such as Splunk, and Salesforce Service Cloud is a plus.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Solutions Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Supports the Commercial Solutions Manager in identifying, designing, prototyping, and implementing practical technology solutions that address business needs and drive measurable impact. Acts as a tech\-savvy business enabler who translates operational requirements into scalable, cost\-effective digital solutions using low\-code/no\-code tools, automation platforms, analytics, and structured problem\-solving approaches.
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities
   

  

**Business Analysis \& Requirement Structuring**
* Work closely with business teams to document processes, pain points, and opportunity areas.
* Translate business needs into structured functional requirements and solution outlines.
* Identify automation and digitalization opportunities.


**Solution Design \& Prototyping**
* Design and build MVPs using low\-code/no\-code platforms, automation tools, dashboards, or workflow systems.
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts before full\-scale IT development.
* Ensure solution design considers scalability, performance, and integration needs.


**Scalability \& Performance Metrics**
* Define and track KPIs related to adoption, performance, cost savings, automation rates, and ROI.
* Analyze scalability indicators such as: Volume handling capacity, User growth impact, Process cycle time, Cost per transaction.
* Flag technical or operational bottlenecks early.


 Key Result Responsibilities\-Continued
   

  

**Process Optimization**
* Map and optimize workflows to eliminate inefficiencies.
* Apply structured problem\-solving methodologies.
* Recommend process improvements supported by digital tools.


**Data Analysis \& Insight Generation**
* Extract and analyze operational and commercial data.
* Use data to validate impact of implemented solutions.


**Governance \& Documentation**
* Maintain clear documentation of solutions, workflows, metrics, and dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with IT governance, data security, and architectural standards.
* Support handover to development teams when scaling beyond MVP stage.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Monitor solution performance post\-implementation.
* Suggest iterations and optimizations.
* Stay updated on emerging tools and cost\-efficient technologies.


**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field
* Strong Understanding of Business Process Mapping \& Optimization
* Strong Knowledge of Low\-Code / No\-Code Solution Development.
* Exposure to low\-code/no\-code tools, workflow automation platforms, or data visualization tools.


 Work Experience
   

  

* 1 year of experience in business analysis, solution analysis, digital transformation, or technology\-enabled operations.
* Experience working in structured IT or digital environments (aviation industry is a plus).

**POSITION SUMMARY** 




 The position of DFMEA Facilitator is responsible for supporting the initiation, management and successful completion of system and subsystem DFMEA documents; and coordinate with engineering functions to support the development of generic exhaust component DFMEA documents for converters, mufflers, and valves. The role includes supporting the identification of program risk through the development, application, and presentation of risk metrics at key program milestone meetings, track maturity level of all project DFMEA’s, and ensure DFMEA Teams follow DFMEA standards. The DFMEA Facilitator will also work in developing and incorporating lessons learned into generic DFMEA templates for common products, and support implementation of industry leading DFMEA methods .
 



 The DFMEA Facilitator will collaborate to capture and institutionalize lessons learned, update generic DFMEA templates, and standardize best practices across global engineering locations. The role also supports the deployment of industry\-leading DFMEA practices, continuous improvement initiatives, and the integration of AIAG\-VDA FMEA standards into product development and risk management processes.
 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* Design FMEA Facilitator: Lead the implementation of the Tenneco FMEA process to the regional organization.
* Evaluation and tracking of regional FMEA related skills and preparing and managing FMEA engineering competency matrix.
* Arrange, manage and conduct FMEA training, ensure training material remains current and representative to standards.
* Ensure project teams follow standard DFMEA procedures and apply the templates and tools effectively.
* Ensure DFMEA content quality, consistency of nomenclature, and normalization of scoring across all projects.
* Develop and maintain a DFMEA database to manage document maturity and versioning.
* Develop and maintain (KPI) metrics on status, completeness, and quality of project DFMEA documents.
* Track and deploy lessons learned from projects and feedback into the generic DFMEA content.
* Accountable for ensuring DFMEA’s for all projects are completed to FMEA standards and quality. Includes the tracking of risk metrics and managing a DFMEA action tracker for each project team.
* Ensure project DFMEA document meets the required maturity level in accordance with each program gate.
* Work extensively as a mentor to provide guidance and training to engineering teams.
* Support failure analysis and problem\-solving activities to ensure DFMEA documents reflect risk identifiers.
* Help project teams to ensure standardization of scoring, risk ranking, application of classification identification, and ensure quality and consistency of defined controls and actions.
* Reviews Design Change Notices and ensures FMEA document change process is followed to assess design change risk as needed with the Design Release Engineer. Creation of DFMEA report for respective project Design and Manufacturing Sign\-Off meetings
* Lead system/subsystem/component generic DFMEA initiatives in conjunction with Global Systems Engineering team
* Advocate for the regional team during the implementation of new AIAG/VDA DFMEA standards.
* Manage and maintain FMEA software tools and templates and develop strategies for conversion into customer specified FMEA formats.
* Conduct continuous improvement activities such as template management, new methods of development, and integration of industry standard FMEA process enhancements.
* Interface with customers as the lead FMEA expert to ensure alignment.

title: Technical Consulting Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Sales Director\- Maharashtra \& Southeast Asia
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process by adapting ABB’s products and solutions to meet customer requirements and specifications. You will guide the selection of optimized products and technologies, prepare technical and commercial documentation, and act as a key technical resource for the assigned area. The role demands a mix of sales acumen, technical understanding, and customer engagement.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Machine Automation Division \-B\&R in Pune region in India. Main stakeholders are Sales, Customers, Engineering, Product Management, Technical Support, and Channel Partners.
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Assess customer requirements and recommend optimal B\&R automation, machine control, and connectivity solutions.
* Support business growth through technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing experience in automation, motion control, advanced technologies, and software solutions.
* Collaborate with sales, engineering, application, and product teams to develop customer\-focused solutions and proposals.
* Provide technical support, customer training, and partner enablement while identifying new business opportunities and supporting market expansion.


**Qualifications for the role:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related field).
* 8–12 years of experience in industrial automation environments, with deep knowledge of PLCs, SCADA, Drives, Motion Control, Servo Systems, and Mechatronics solutions.
* Practical experience in machine study, automation application development, and designing automation architectures to meet customer and industry requirements.
* Experience in servo sizing, motor sizing, digital simulation, and developing optimized motion control solutions.
* Industry experience in Printing, Packaging, Plastics, Pharma, and Life Sciences sectors, with a solid understanding of machine functionalities and automation solutions.
* Experience in Business Development and Application Engineering, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical business solutions and support growth initiatives.
* Strong communication, customer engagement, and relationship management skills, with willingness to travel; fluency in English is required, and knowledge of an additional regional language is an advantage.


**More about us:**
 B\&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B\&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B\&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics \& Discrete Automation division.

description:
**Job Title: Officer/Senior Officer (Central Project Management Unit)** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Travel: As per the project need** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




 This position is responsible for centrally driving the strategic outcome for the Catalyst program of Lend A Hand India under the guidance of Manager\-CPMU. (Catalyst program is spread in 20\+ States of India where our State PMU teams provide strategic support to State Govts on Skill Education to drive key outcomes). This position is responsible for (i) building/updating strategic knowledge products for Skill Education delivery at Scale (e.g\-Training, Skill Labs, Books, Internship, Skill Teachers onboarding etc) in all State Govt schools (ii) Work with 20\+ State PMU teams to drive outcome at state level through the support of these knowledge produced created (iii) Act as central knowledge expert for some of the skill education area to whom different State PMUs can reach out (iv) Advocate the utilization of knowledge products by Senior bureaucrats (IAS), District Officials, School HMs/Teachers for their better decision making, planning in relation to Skill Education delivery at Scale.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Building/updating strategic knowledge products for Skill Education delivery at Scale (e.g\-Training, Skill Labs, Books, Internship, Skill Teachers onboarding etc) in all State Govt schools. Products example: Knowledge PPT for IAS official; SOPs on these areas, Concept notes, Best Practices documentation etc
* Working with 20\+ State PMU teams to drive outcome at state level through the support of these knowledge produced created
* Act as central knowledge expert for some of the skill education area to whom different State PMUs can reach out
* Advocate the utilization of knowledge products by Senior bureaucrats (IAS), District Officials, School HMs/Teachers for their better decision making, planning in relation to Skill Education delivery at Scale.
* Keeping tab of what is happening in 20\+ States Skill Education implementation through LAHI State PMU teams \& drive outcomes accordingly through CPMU team
* Maintain/Update Central Trackers: which gives insights on what is happening in 20\+ States Skill Education delivery to Senior Leadership of the org
* Need based Visit to different States: to understand State level implementation; advocate about strategic areas to State \& District level Govt officials; get trained on self\-capacity building through State visit exposure etc
* Team Meetings: Organize, lead, or facilitate meetings and events involving LAHI teams \& external stakeholders as per need
* Take up any other work \& opportunity as part of Central PMU team under the guidance of Manager\-CPMU \& Head\-CPMU team of Lend A Hand India



  





**About Lend A Hand India :** 
 Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading multi\-state Think Tank/NGO org working in the school\-based Skill education domain for the last 20 years having partnership with 20\+ States/UTs across India. At its core, Lend A Hand India strives to facilitate the "school to work" transition of 14\-18 years old school children. Its project management teams provide Systems change support to the State Samagra Shiksha/ State Education dept offices across India, in alignment with the Co\-Impact (a donor collaborative of Gates/Rockefeller/Skoll/Nilekanis etc) vision and mission of sustainable change. Currently, 20,000\+ schools and 25 lakh \+ students are a part of this program with around 300\+ team members working Pan\-India.
 



 The majority of our work is in partnership with the State governments by helping the state governments to scale up school\-based Skill education in the state under ‘Samagra Shiksha’ scheme of Ministry of Education \& with Central Govt \& National Skilling \& Education bodies to come out with better policy/guidelines for Skill education ecosystem to ensure easier adoption by State Govt.
 



  





**Our Mission** 




 Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education
 



  





**Our Approach** 



* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central\-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem



  





**Our Knowledge in Action** 




 Through the design \& execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250\+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20\+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.
 



  





**Our Reach** 




 LAHI’s current scale of work includes \-
 


* 20\+ States and UTs
* 15000\+ Schools
* 15 Lakh\+ Students
* 250\+ Team Members



  





**What Truly Sets a Career at Lend A Hand India Apart –** 



* **Work as a Systems Architect, not just an Implementer:** 
 You help build and refine the system itself, influencing policy and creating lasting change.
* **Experience the thrill of scale with depth:** 
 See your ideas and efforts replicated across thousands of schools, impacting millions of students in a measurable way.
* **Master Complex Collaboration:** 
 Gain unparalleled experience navigating and synergizing the worlds of government, corporate CSR, and community.
* **Career with a Tangible Legacy:** 
 Your work directly creates skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and a stronger national economy.
* **Investment in you:** 
 We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive support \& robust benefits and a culture that actively champions your professional development and holistic well\-being.



  





**Minimum Experience:** 




 1\. Overall experience of 2\-5\+ years in Education project \& working on Govt Projects at State/District level
 



 2\. Prior experience of Education/Skill Development /Govt fellowship preferable (Gandhi, TFI, MGNF etc)
 



 3\. Prior experience of working in Govt PMU (preferable)
 



 4\. Experience in Program Management / Monitoring / relevant fields (desirable)
 



 5\. Prior experience of working in Govt department PMU setup, working with Senior bureaucrat (IAS officials) at State level is preferred
 



  





**Educational Background:**

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation and Proposals
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, providing engineered solutions for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes Waste Heat Boilers (WHRB), Thermal Oxidizers, Process Burners, Boiler Burners, Flares, Vapor Recovery Systems, Incinerators, and Combustion Control Systems.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Estimation \& Proposals Engineer** 
 with expertise in
 **Waste Heat Boilers (WHRB)** 
 and
 **Control \& Instrumentation (C\&I)** 
 estimation to support techno\-commercial proposal preparation, cost estimation, and bid execution.
   

  

 The incumbent will be responsible for preparing accurate techno\-commercial estimates and proposals for Waste Heat Boiler projects, including associated Control \& Instrumentation (C\&I) systems. The role requires close coordination with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, finance, planning, and project execution teams to develop competitive bids while ensuring technical compliance and cost optimization.
   

  

 Experience in
 **EPC/OEM organizations** 
 involved in Waste Heat Boilers, Fired Heaters, Heat Recovery Systems, or industrial boiler projects will be preferred. Experience in estimating complete boiler packages along with C\&I scope will be a significant advantage.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10 to 15\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Baner, Pune
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Proposal \& Tender Management:**
* Review customer RFQs, tender specifications, datasheets, P\&IDs, BOQs, and commercial requirements.
* Prepare complete techno\-commercial proposals for Waste Heat Boiler packages and associated C\&I systems.
* Identify technical deviations, exclusions, qualifications, and commercial risks.
* Coordinate bid clarification meetings with customers and internal stakeholders.


**Cost Estimation:** 
  

  

* Review Bills of Material (BOM), technical specifications, and approved vendor lists received from Engineering and Marketing.
* Prepare detailed cost estimates for:
+ Waste Heat Boilers
+ Pressure Parts
+ Structural Steel
+ Piping
+ Valves
+ Fans
+ Pumps
+ Burners
+ Instruments
+ PLC/DCS/SCADA
+ MCCs
+ Electrical packages
+ Bought\-Out (BO) equipment

* Float RFQs to vendors and evaluate commercial and technical quotations.
* Coordinate with Procurement for vendor pricing and fabrication rates.
* Work with Manufacturing to estimate fabrication and shop man\-hours.
* Coordinate with Construction and Project teams to estimate erection, commissioning, modularization, and export packaging costs.
* Estimate engineering, design, documentation, inspection, logistics, and contingency costs.


**C\&I Scope Estimation:** 
  

  

* Prepare cost estimates for complete Control \& Instrumentation packages including:
+ PLC architecture
+ Field instrumentation
+ Control valves
+ Shut\-off valves
+ Flame monitoring systems
+ Safety interlocks
+ Cable schedules
+ Junction boxes
+ Marshalling panels
+ Control panels
+ MCC interfaces

* Evaluate instrument vendor quotations and prepare technical\-commercial comparisons.
* Coordinate with C\&I Engineering to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.


**Cost Optimization:**
* Perform cost optimization studies and value engineering exercises.
* Evaluate alternative materials, equipment, and vendors to improve competitiveness.
* Prepare take\-offs, add\-on calculations, and cost\-saving recommendations.
* Monitor raw material price trends, steel prices, and vendor rate contracts.
* Develop and maintain cost databases for fabricated and bought\-out items.


**Budgeting \& Project Handover:**
* Participate in Order Transfer Meetings after project award.
* Prepare Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)\-wise project budgets.
* Upload and release approved budgets into ERP systems.
* Support Project Management and Procurement during post\-order execution by explaining budget assumptions and estimation basis.


**Cost Control:**
* Participate in project cost review meetings with Finance, Projects, Planning, Procurement, and Marketing.
* Monitor project cost overruns and identify opportunities for savings.
* Evaluate Cost Change Notes (CCNs) and recommend approvals based on technical and commercial justification.
* Support project teams in resolving budget\-related issues throughout execution.


**Cross Functional Coordination:** 
  

  

* Collaborate with:
+ Proposal Engineering
+ Mechanical Engineering
+ C\&I Engineering
+ Procurement
+ Manufacturing
+ Quality
+ Planning
+ Finance
+ Logistics
+ Project Management

* Ensure timely submission of accurate and competitive proposals.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Waste Heat Boiler estimation and proposal preparation
* Pressure Parts and Boiler Components
* ASME Section I \& Section VIII
* TEMA (preferred)
* Control \& Instrumentation estimation
* PLC / DCS / SCADA architecture
* Instrumentation and Control Valves
* BOM preparation and costing
* Vendor offer evaluation
* Cost estimation methodologies
* Cost optimization and value engineering
* Engineering man\-hour estimation
* Fabrication and erection cost estimation
* WBS budgeting
* Commercial proposal preparation
* Risk assessment
* Cost control
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, IFS or equivalent)
* Advanced Microsoft Excel


**Preferred Industry Experience**
 Candidates should have experience in one or more of the following industries:
   

  

* Waste Heat Boilers (WHRB)
* Fired Heaters
* Thermal Oxidizers
* Heat Recovery Systems
* Boiler OEMs
* Process Equipment
* Power Plants
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refinery
* EPC Organizations


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen
* Excellent negotiation and vendor evaluation skills
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple bids simultaneously under tight deadlines
* Proactive approach toward cost optimization and continuous improvement


**Qualification**
* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Instrumentation, Chemical, or equivalent.
* Additional certification in Cost Engineering or Project Management is an added advantage.

title: Technical Support Engineering, Engineer - Structural
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 Join our Customer Excellence team as a Technical Support Engineer I supporting customers in Japan who use our structural simulation products. Based in India, you will work closely with the Japan support team to assist with technical inquiries related to customers’ real\-world engineering simulation projects and the integration of our software into their design workflows. Depending on the case complexity, you will either support investigations with the Japan team or communicate directly with customers under guidance from experienced engineers.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level or early\-career position designed for an engineer who has a sound foundation in structural mechanics and finite element analysis, an interest in customer\-facing technical work, and a strong willingness to learn. You will develop your technical and customer support capabilities through collaboration with senior engineers and subject matter experts.
   

  

 You will use your engineering knowledge, available technical resources, and AI\-based platforms to diagnose issues, identify solutions, document technical knowledge, and help customers use our products successfully.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide first\- or second line technical support for structural simulation products to customers in Japan and to members of the Japan support team.
* Work with the Japan support team to understand customer questions, reproduce reported issues, collect relevant technical information, and investigate potential solutions.
* Depending on the case and your level of technical readiness, communicate directly with customers and manage technical support cases from initial inquiry through resolution.
* Apply fundamental knowledge of structural mechanics, finite element analysis, numerical methods, and simulation techniques to diagnose customer issues.
* Provide clear, accurate, and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders in English and, where applicable, Japanese \- Fluent speaking, reading, and writing skills are a strong advantage but are not mandatory.
* Recognize when a technical issue requires deeper expertise and escalate it promptly to a senior engineer or subject matter expert, providing a clear summary of the issue, investigation performed, and findings.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, developers, product specialists, and other support teams to resolve customer issues.
* Learn and apply established troubleshooting processes, simulation best practices, and customer support procedures.
* Create and update technical documentation, troubleshooting notes, frequently asked questions, and knowledge\-base content for customers and internal teams.
* Perform data manipulation, preparation, validation, and analysis tasks as required to support technical investigations, knowledge development, and customer support operations.
* Submit product improvement suggestions and defect reports when appropriate, following established processes and with guidance from senior team members.
* Assist with verification of product fixes and application testing of new product releases, as assigned.
* Use available resources, including AI\-based support platforms, responsibly and effectively to complement engineering analysis and improve support quality.
* Continuously develop technical expertise in one or more structural simulation areas.
* Build an understanding of Japanese customers’ engineering workflows, business expectations, and communication requirements.
* Contribute to high customer satisfaction through responsiveness, professionalism, teamwork, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Participate in other team and company initiatives as needed.
* Remain flexible and open to new responsibilities based on business and customer needs.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Sound academic or practical knowledge of structural mechanics and finite element analysis.
* Basic understanding of numerical simulation methods and the ability to interpret engineering results.
* Demonstrated logical problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate technical issues systematically.
* Ability to communicate fluently and effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in India, Japan, and other global locations.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance or escalating issues when appropriate.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset, professional conduct, and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Engineering curiosity and a strong commitment to continuous learning.
* Ability to work effectively across different cultures, locations, and time zones.
* Willingness to work hours that provide reasonable coverage and collaboration with the Japan support team, subject to applicable company policies and local employment requirements.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 0\-2 Years of experience using structural simulation, finite element analysis, or related engineering software. Relevant university research, academic projects, internships, or industrial experience may be considered.
* Experience using commercial or internally developed FEA software for engineering applications.
* Familiarity with structural analysis workflows, including linear or nonlinear analysis.
* Experience in a technical support, customer\-facing, consulting, application engineering, or engineering services environment.
* Japanese\-language proficiency.
* Experience communicating or collaborating with customers or colleagues in Japan.
* Basic knowledge of Python, scripting, automation, SQL, databases, machine learning, or generative AI.
* Experience participating in an engineering product development or software testing cycle.
* Willingness to travel occasionally, if required.


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will be part of the Synopsys Customer Excellence team, a global group of engineers focused on making customers successful with Synopsys simulation software. The team works across time zones and technical domains, supporting customers through their toughest engineering challenges and helping drive adoption of Synopsys Structural Products. You will collaborate closely with colleagues who share your commitment to solving hard problems and delivering high\-quality support.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*

* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment\-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education

* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top\-line growth and improve profitability


**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing\-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow\-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad\-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.


**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5\-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared \& MBA Finance

*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AO/Program & Operations Associate, Family Engagement
description:
**Program \& Operations Associate, Family Engagement**
**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Business:** 
 UHNW, Family Engagement
   

  

**About Family Engagement**
 Bernstein’s Family Engagement team helps ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals and families navigate the complex human, relational, and practical dimensions of significant wealth. The team develops programs, research, resources, and experiences that support families as they communicate across generations, prepare rising leaders, define shared goals, and make thoughtful decisions about wealth, legacy, governance, and family continuity.
   

  

 Working closely with advisors and internal partners, Family Engagement provides differentiated support for Bernstein’s most complex client relationships through education, facilitation, thought leadership, peer engagement, and customized family\-focused programming. The team plays an important role in helping advisors deepen relationships with clients and deliver a more holistic experience beyond investment management.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Family Engagement team is seeking an India\-based Program \& Operations Associate to provide high\-quality execution, coordination, reporting, and process support across a growing set of Family Engagement initiatives. This role will initially focus on core program administration, team operating leverage, reporting, content workflow support, survey administration, and platform maintenance. Over time, as the individual builds context and credibility with the team, the role may expand into broader strategic, analytical, research, and AI\-enabled support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable supporting senior stakeholders in a global, follow\-the\-sun working model. This person should be able to operate, with direction, minimal day\-to\-day oversight, identify opportunities for process improvement, and bring a high standard of professionalism to work that supports advisors, clients, and internal teams serving ultra\-high\-net\-worth families.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program and Operations Support**
* Support recurring Family Engagement programs, including Leadership Accelerator, peer\-to\-peer initiatives, surveys, family meeting preparation, participant communications, and post\-session follow\-up.
* Coordinate pre\- and post\-session materials, distribution lists, reminder emails, recap communications, recordings, survey links, and related trackers.
* Assist with team operating needs, including resource requests, scheduling support, expense tracking, T\&E coordination, quarterly business reporting, and recurring internal updates.
* Maintain team trackers, templates, calendars, dashboards, and reporting tools to ensure information is current, accurate, and easy to access.


**Reporting, Metrics, and Business Insights**
* Prepare recurring reports and summaries related to program activity, participation, ROI metrics, LAB activity, peer\-to\-peer engagement, and other key business indicators.
* Support the maintenance and interpretation of dashboards, trackers, and other reporting tools.
* Help the team improve how program activity, deliverables, outcomes, and follow\-up items are captured, organized, and communicated.
* Identify trends, gaps, or recurring needs that can help the team better prioritize work and improve service delivery.


**Content, Research, and Workflow Coordination**
* Support quote\-check processes for blogs, research, and thought leadership, including pulling quotes, updating trackers, preparing outreach, monitoring responses, and escalating edits or approvals.
* Assist with survey administration for research, LAB, peer\-to\-peer sessions, and family meetings.
* Maintain and refresh Family Engagement content on Seismic, including newly published research, blogs, key dates, program materials, and related collateral.
* Refresh existing materials, with direction, to ensure visuals, data, session content, and supporting resources remain current.
* Support first\-pass research, competitive scans, social media drafts, event summaries, and internal communications as the role evolves.


**Process Improvement and AI\-Enabled Efficiency**
* Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency through templates, workflow enhancements, better use of existing platforms, and approved AI tools.
* Stay current with approved internal AI tools and suggest practical ways the team can use them to streamline administrative, reporting, research, and communication workflows.
* Help standardize repeatable processes so senior team members can focus more time on advisor/client engagement and higher\-value strategic work.
* Support the future administration of tools, platforms, or processes adopted by the Family Engagement team as the business scales.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in project coordination, program management, business operations, research support, marketing operations, client service support, or a related function.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workflows, deadlines, and stakeholders.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, polished emails, summaries, and internal updates.
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.
* Experience with Salesforce, Seismic, SurveyMonkey, Power BI, or similar platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting U.S.\-based stakeholders, senior professionals, or global teams preferred.
* Interest in wealth management, UHNW client engagement, family office, leadership development, research, or related areas preferred.


**Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate**
**What Will Make Someone Successful in This Role**
* Intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to problem solving.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly for advisor\-facing, client\-facing, or senior leader\-facing materials.
* Sound judgment, including knowing when to act independently and when to escalate.
* Proactive problem\-solving orientation, with an interest in improving repeatable processes and team workflows.
* Adaptability and comfort working in a growing business where priorities may evolve over time.
* Professionalism, discretion, and an appreciation for the needs of ultra\-high\-net\-worth clients and the advisors who serve them.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, including approved AI\-enabled resources, to create efficiency and leverage for the team.


 Shift Timing: 5:00 PM to 1:30 AM IST

title: Pega Business Architect / Analyst - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Pega Business Architect / Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, process design, and delivery governance for Pega Business Process Management (BPM) and Case Management implementations. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model requiring office attendance two days per week, this role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, translating operational transformation objectives into scalable Pega workflow solutions. The position is ideally suited to professionals with strong expertise in Pega BPM, process modelling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead requirements workshops with business stakeholders and delivery teams to capture and document current and future\-state process flows for Pega BPM initiatives.
   

  

 Model and document end\-to\-end business processes using BPMN, case lifecycles, and workflow diagrams to support solution delivery.
   

  

 Design case types, stages, processes, flows, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
   

  

 Collaborate with Pega architects and developers to ensure workflow designs align with platform best practices, case management capabilities, and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

 Conduct fit\-gap assessments between business requirements and Pega platform capabilities, recommending configuration\-led solutions where appropriate.
   

  

 Define and govern business rules, decision tables, decision trees, routing logic, and escalation workflows.
   

  

 Maintain end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements through design, testing, and deployment.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Experience of 5\+ years in enterprise IT and business analysis, including 4\+ years focused on Pega implementations.
   

  

 Strong functional expertise in Pega BPM and Case Management, including case design, stages, processes, SLAs, work parties, and routing.
   

  

 Proficiency in BPMN process modelling and translating business processes into effective Pega case designs.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Pega decisioning capabilities including decision tables, decision trees, and when rules.
   

  

 Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies, ideally SAFe, with exposure to Scrum and Kanban practices.
   

  

 Ability to create high\-quality business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and user stories.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across business, architecture, engineering, testing, data, and integration teams.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to shape enterprise\-wide business transformation programmes through Pega BPM and Case Management solutions.
   

  

 Exposure to multi\-market and global stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Hybrid working model based in Pune.
   

  

 Opportunity to collaborate with business leaders, architects, product teams, and technology specialists across complex programmes.
   

  

 Involvement in strategic process improvement, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Exposure to emerging technologies including low\-code platforms, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced Pega BPM and Case Management design practices.
   

  

 Enterprise\-scale process modelling and workflow transformation techniques.
   

  

 Fit\-gap analysis and business architecture methodologies.
   

  

 Agile and SAFe delivery governance approaches.
   

  

 End\-to\-end requirements traceability and business analysis best practices.
   

  

 Stakeholder engagement and executive\-level presentation capabilities.
   

  

 Automation strategy development and AI\-assisted workflow design concepts.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

title: Science Communicator on contract (Physics, Chemistry and Medicine)

title: Product Analyst
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Elicits, analyzes, specifies, and validates the business needs of stakeholders, be they customers or end users.
* Collaborates with project sponsors to determine project scope and vision.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Identifies and establishes scope and parameters of requirements analysis on a project\-by\-project basis to define project impact, outcome criteria, and metrics.
* Works with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Researches, reviews, and analyses the effectiveness of existing requirements\-gathering processes and develop strategies for enhancing or further applying these processes.
* Helps conduct research on products to meet agreed upon requirements and to support purchasing efforts.
* Participates in the QA of solutions to ensure features and functions have been enabled and optimized.
* Participates in the selection of any requirements documentation software solutions that the organization may opt to use.
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Develops and utilizes standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Creates process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Develops and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted.
* Assists with the interpretation of customer requirements into feasible options, and communicating these back to the business stakeholders.
* Manages and tracks the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicates changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — verbally or through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* You will report to manager \- IT


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
   

  

 Typically requires 8 years of related experience (project Management, Process Improvement and data management experience)
   

  

 Communicate the plan and priorities for the Program Increment and define the PI goals
   

  

 Drive release behavior, incenting discipline and quality over speed
   

  

 Determine resource requirements and partner with Tech Lead or Business Owner on sourcing talent
   

  

 Integrates change management elements needed to support the desired state;
   

  

 Track key delivery issues and risks and escalating as needed.
   

  

 Accountable for validation of acceptance criteria met before accepting completed features and definition of done
   

  

 Overall responsibility to manage the Epic and Feature backlogs and Themes for measuring to key objectives, value delivery.
   

  

 Collaborate and shape design, development and implementation requirements with partners and engineering team members.
   

  

 Be responsible for training and support documentation, as well as business readiness \& service transition
   

  

 Provides consultative support in financial management, organizational change, vendor management, and operational excellence to business lead technology initiatives and to our business or enterprise shared services teams
   

  

 Provide analysis on key business drivers and metrics using the latest analytics \& visualization technology.
   

  

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 or
   

  

 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

**Job Family Group:**
 Operations \- Core
   

  

 \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
   

  

**Job Family:**
 Operations Project Management
   

  

 \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

* Ability to work on\-site in the Pune Division, collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, and communicate clearly in written and verbal formats.
* Proficiency in basic engineering software (e.g., MS Excel, AutoCAD or equivalent) and willingness to learn specialized water modeling tools.
