title: Electronic Systems Product Specialist
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates electronic application and systems problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and improves electronic application and systems development processes and tools. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP\&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required. Obtains input from customers, technical and product teams, manufacturing engineers, supplier partners, and other stakeholders to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Makes decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical system design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of calibrated subsystems and feature classes of electronic subsystems. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems \- Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.
   

  

 Machine Integration and Optimization \- Combines various parts or sub\-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem\-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Provide technical and application engineering support to Mining and Construction OEMs by understanding customer requirements, supporting engine and electronic system integration, managing calibration\-related activities, and ensuring successful execution of customer projects. The role serves as the primary technical interface between OEM customers and Cummins cross\-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the primary technical contact for Industrial Markets segments Construction and Mining OEM customers.
* Work closely with OEMs to understand vehicle/equipment requirements and translate them into Cummins engine and system requirements.
* Support application engineering activities for Industrial Markets segments mining and Construction projects from concept through production.
* Review customer requirements and identify engine, aftertreatment, and electronic control system impacts.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering, Calibration, Controls, and Systems teams to define and implement required changes.
* Identify calibration requirements and support calibration development, validation, and deployment activities.
* Support engine electronic system integration, including ECM configuration and troubleshooting.
* Provide expertise on CAN communication architecture, J1939 communication protocols, and electronic system interfaces.
* Support OEM harness design, electrical integration, and validation activities.
* Review customer electrical schematics and ensure compliance with Cummins integration guidelines.
* Manage product releases, documentation updates, and engineering change activities through Cummins PLM processes.
* Support project planning, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and customer deliverables.
* Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, validation activities, and field issue investigations.
* Support new product introductions and ongoing product improvement initiatives within the Mining and Construction segments.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of diesel engine systems and engine electronics.
* Experience with Engine Control Modules (ECM) and electronic engine controls.
* Knowledge of CAN communication protocols (J1939 preferred).
* Experience in OEM electrical harness design and development.
* Understanding of engine integration, controls, sensors, and actuators.
* Familiarity with calibration processes and change management activities.
* Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and engineering release processes.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.

description:
**About Energy Exemplar** 




 In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award\-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 
 



 Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:
 


* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025\) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025\) – E\+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025\) \- Winners*

* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024\) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024\) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*



**How We Work** 




 Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.
 



 We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.
 



 Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity \& Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.
 



**About the Role** 




 Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self\-motivated and professional person for the role of Energy Market Analyst in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.
 



**Responsibilities:**
 •    Learn our software to an advanced level
   

 •    Provide technical support to customers and track support cases from start to finish
   

 •    Work with clients to resolve issues related to our SaaS/Cloud offerings and our Desktop version
   

 •    Collaborate with Cloud Developers and Engine/GUI Developers to ensure issues are resolved and development requests are properly documented
   

 •    Provide onsite and web\-based trainings to existing and potential clients
   

 •    Maintain and update training materials
   

 •    Compose articles and produce videos to educate clients and to market our software.
   

 •    Construct tools and examples that clients can utilize to more effectively utilize our software
   

 •    Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms
   

 •    Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends and developments
   

 •    Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed
   

 •    Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
   

 •    Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
   

 •    Travel to client sites as required
 



**Qualifications, Skills \& Experiences:**
 •    Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.
   

 •    Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
   

 •    Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high\-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers
   

 •    Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities
   

 •    Team player, with the ability to be a self\-starter and work independently as needed.
 



**Education:**
 •    2 to 4 years of demonstrated working knowledge of power plant operations, electricity and gas markets.
   

 •    Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
   

 •    Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings
   

 •    Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
   

 •    Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
   

 •    Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
   

 •    Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models.
   

 •    Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.
 



**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
 This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:
 



 •    Indian Development Centre colleagues
   

 •    Senior IDC Management
   

 •    Chief Product Officer
   

 •    Global Product Delivery Team
   

 •    Global Product Development Team
   

 •    Global Support Team
 



  
 



 Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

description:
****Job Requirements****
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

****Job Summary****
**The Technical Writer is responsible for converting, migrating, formatting, and maintaining technical documentation from legacy formats, primarily PDF documents and, where applicable, Adobe FrameMaker source files, into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines. The role involves ensuring document accuracy, formatting consistency, content integrity, and compliance with established documentation requirements. The Technical Writer will support documentation modernization initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality technical publications.**
****Minimum Requirements****
 A successful candidate will have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Technical Writing, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution, OR equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of five (5\) years of experience in technical writing, document conversion, content migration, or technical documentation management.
* Strong command of the English language, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and accurately.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Word, including styles, templates, section breaks, page layouts, tables, captions, headers and footers, cross\-references, and document formatting.
* Experience working with PDF\-based technical documentation.
* Experience converting and formatting technical documents in Microsoft Word while maintaining content accuracy and consistency.
* Basic familiarity with Adobe FrameMaker is desirable but not mandatory.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar documentation tools.
* Proficiency in Simplified Technical English (STE) is desirable.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs, wiring diagrams, and schematic diagrams.
* Experience collaborating with SMEs to validate technical content and resolve documentation issues.
* Experience working effectively in global teams with flexible schedules.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve document formatting and content issues.
* Fundamental project management skills, including the ability to manage priorities and meet established deadlines.


****Responsibilities****
* Migrating and converting technical documentation from PDF and, where required, Adobe FrameMaker formats into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines.
* Applying approved Baker Hughes document templates, formatting standards, branding requirements, and style conventions to all converted documents.
* Preserving document structure, formatting, tables, images, captions, numbering schemes, headers and footers, and technical content during the conversion process.

 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.

**About The Learning Experience Coordinator...**
 The Learning Experience Coordinator plays an important role in bringing learning programs to life at SiteMinder by supporting both day\-to\-day learning operations and digital content delivery.
   

  

 This role supports the design, build, and rollout of learning experiences across global teams. The focus is on execution, consistency, and learner experience, ensuring learning content is published accurately, kept up to date, and easy to access.
   

  

 The Coordinator supports instructional design activities by helping turn business and product knowledge into clear, learner\-friendly materials that align with SiteMinder’s brand and learning standards.

* Manage LMS activities including assignments, enrolments, content uploads, and updates.
* Coordinate the scheduling and structure of onboarding programs across regions (EMEA, APAC, AMERS), ensuring sessions, modules, and timelines align with cohort start dates.
* Monitor onboarding capacity, session coverage, and regional logistics to ensure consistent learner experience globally.
* Support continuous optimisation of the onboarding journey, identifying gaps in flow, duplication, or learner overload.
* Collect learner feedback and share insights to support continuous improvement.
* Track completion rates, learner engagement, and basic learning metrics.


**Wat you have...**
* Experience with learning platforms and digital tools
* Confident working with LMS platforms and using digital tools to build, publish, and update learning content. Experience with authoring or content tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Storylane, Google Workspace, or similar tools is a plus.
* Able to write learner\-facing content, instructions, and communications that are easy to understand.
* Able to juggle competing priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment. Interest in learning, training, or education
* Comfortable following defined processes, maintaining quality standards, and flagging issues early to keep delivery running smoothly.
* Able to review simple learning data (e.g. completions or engagement) and use it to spot issues or opportunities for improvement.

title: Monitoring and Documentation Officer
description:
Role: Monitoring and Documentation Officer
 



 Location: Pune
 



  






 Job Purpose
 





 The Monitoring and Documentation Officer will support the effective implementation, tracking, documentation, reporting, and knowledge management processes of the Transform Schools programme. S/He/They will be responsible for collecting quality data by following established processes, maintaining accurate programme records, tracking implementation progress, coordinating routine data collection, compiling field evidence, developing written and photo\-based case studies, and documenting programme learnings, insights, success stories, and best practices.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 



1. Programme Monitoring and Tracking


* Develop Project Management and Evaluation Plan (PMEP) and track programme activities against approved work plans and implementation timelines.
* Maintain updated records of school visits, trainings, meetings, workshops, assessments, and field activities.
* Support programme teams in collecting routine implementation data from districts, schools, and field staff.
* Ensure timely consolidation of activity reports and progress updates from field teams.
* Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual programme progress summaries.



  






 2\. Documentation and Knowledge Management
 



* Develop and maintain organised documentation systems (digital and physical) for programme records.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data collection, processing, and reporting to support evidence\-based decision\-making and knowledge sharing..
* Compile training reports, meeting minutes, attendance records, field visit reports, photographs, case studies, and other supporting evidence.
* Document programme learnings, best practices, innovations, and field\-level experiences.
* Draft success stories, human\-interest stories, and short programme briefs for internal and external communication.
* Support the preparation of donor documentation and programme communication materials.


- 


  






 3\. Data Compilation, Record Management and Analysis
 



* Compile quantitative and qualitative programme data received from field teams.
* Ensure completeness and consistency of data entries before submission to the central programme team.
* Maintain updated databases and trackers for programme activities and outputs.
* Support data cleaning, verification, and analysis using EXCEL, PYTHON, R, etc., in coordination with programme and M\&E teams.
* Ensure safe storage and retrieval of programme records and supporting documents.
* Lead the design, management, and continuous improvement of digital data collection systems to ensure timely, accurate, and efficient programme data capture.



  






 4\. Reporting Support
 



* Support the preparation of periodic programme reports by collating field inputs and documentation.
* Coordinate with programme teams to obtain timely updates and supporting evidence for reporting requirements.
* Assist in formatting reports, presentations, annexures, and documentation packages.
* Ensure that all reports are submitted within agreed timelines and in the required format.



  






 Essential Requirements 
 



* Bachelor's degree in social sciences, education, public administration, development studies, statistics, economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in programme monitoring, documentation, reporting, MIS, or administrative support in the education or development sector.
* Experience in maintaining programme records, compiling reports, and managing documentation systems.
* Familiarity with data collection formats, data analysis processes, spreadsheets, dashboard development, and digital documentation tools.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Sheets and Documents) and cloud\-based file management systems; familiarity with digital data collection tools such as KoboToolbox will be an advantage.
* Strong written communication skills in English, Marathi, and Hindi; ability to prepare clear and concise reports and documentation.
* Good organisational and time\-management skills with attention to detail.

 This role provides opportunities to work with global cross\-functional product teams and gain deep knowledge of enterprise software products and technologies.  The position offers exposure to global stakeholders, enabling you to enhance your collaboration, leadership, and project management skills.

 Writers work in a comfortable, respectful environment and are treated as peers across departments. Technical documentation is required and valued as part of most products. Each writer’s role is important to the writing team’s contribution and the overall success of those products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with engineers, developers, product managers, offering managers, and subject matter experts to collect, validate, and update technical information.

* Bachelor’s Degree in technical writing, communications, engineering, journalism, English, technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.


**Qualifications**
**Background**

* 3\+ years of experience in the technical writing domain.
* Proven experience in creating technical documents from scratch, including planning, structuring, writing, and publishing content.

* Must have hands\-on experience using documentation tools \- Adobe FrameMaker, Microsoft Office, Adobe InDesign, and/or AEM Guides.

title: Associate - Technical Content | HigherEducation
description:
**upGrad Private Limited \- www.upgrad.com** 




  





**About Us \-** 




 upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry\-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital\-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.
 



  





**Designation** 
 – Associate \- Technical Content (HigherEducation)
 



**Work Location** 
 – Pune
 



**Work Mode** 
 – In\-Office
 



  





**Job Overview \-** 




 We are looking for a technically strong, deeply curious
 **Associate \- Technical Content Research \& Learning** 
 to work closely with the creator. This is not a traditional social\-media or YouTube\-operations role. The primary responsibility is to research technical topics deeply, identify what is worth teaching, and help convert complex engineering concepts into accurate, engaging, and pedagogically sound content. The role will span three areas:
 **Technical Content Research for YouTube, Content Strategy and Curriculum Planning** 
 , and designing the learning journey for learners who move from videos into structured courses on the LMS. The ideal candidate should have excellent hands\-on command of DSA, strong software\-engineering fundamentals, and the curiosity to independently understand unfamiliar systems and technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




**Technical Content Research \-** 



* Research DSA, software engineering, system design, backend, databases, distributed systems, AI engineering, and other relevant technology topics for upcoming videos.
* Go beyond surface\-level internet research: read documentation, engineering blogs, papers, codebases, interview discussions, benchmarks, and credible technical sources to build accurate context.
* Break down difficult concepts from first principles and identify the misconceptions, edge cases, examples, analogies, and practical insights that would make a topic genuinely useful to learners.
* Validate technical accuracy of ideas, examples, code snippets, diagrams, and claims before they are used in content.
* Build research briefs for each video containing the core question, audience confusion, key concepts, examples, counter\-intuitive insights, references, and recommended teaching flow.



  





**Content Strategy \& Ideation \-** 



* Identify high\-value topics based on learner problems, interview preparation needs, software\-engineering relevance, emerging technology shifts, and gaps in existing educational content.
* Help build weekly and monthly content calendars across DSA, System Design / Software Engineering, and AI Engineering.
* Study strong technology educators, creators, courses, communities, and content formats to understand what makes technical education clear, engaging, and differentiated.
* Work with the creator to turn research into strong video ideas, hooks, outlines, series, and long\-term content pillars without compromising technical depth.
* Use YouTube performance data and learner feedback to identify which topics, explanations, formats, and series should be expanded, changed, or discontinued.



  





**Learning Design \& LMS Pedagogy \-** 



* Design the learning journey for students who discover a topic on YouTube and continue learning it on the LMS.
* Convert broad topics into structured modules, lessons, prerequisites, practice exercises, checkpoints, assignments, projects, and revision paths.
* Design pedagogy that moves learners from intuition to understanding to implementation to practice, rather than simply organising a collection of videos.
* Create or review DSA problem sets, examples, coding exercises, concept checks, and assessments aligned with the learning objective of each module.
* Identify where learners are likely to struggle and design scaffolding, hints, worked examples, prerequisite refreshers, and progressive difficulty accordingly.
* Ensure continuity between free YouTube content and deeper LMS learning so that the transition feels natural and valuable.



  





**Collaboration \& Execution \-** 



* Work closely with the creator during ideation, research, outlining, and curriculum design.
* Coordinate with video editors, designers, platform teams, or other collaborators when technical context is needed for execution.
* Maintain organised research repositories, source lists, topic backlogs, curriculum documents, and content calendars.
* Stay consistently curious about new engineering ideas, tools, architectures, research, and discussions across the software industry.



  





**What We Are Looking For \-** 



* Excellent hands\-on understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms. You should be comfortable solving problems, explaining multiple approaches, analysing time and space complexity, and teaching the reasoning behind a solution.
* Strong computer\-science and software\-engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with areas such as operating systems, databases, networking, backend engineering, APIs, caching, concurrency, and distributed systems is highly desirable.
* Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technical topics independently and go deep enough to explain them accurately.
* Excellent research instincts: you should know how to distinguish a useful primary source from superficial or recycled content.
* Ability to simplify complex topics without oversimplifying or losing technical correctness.
* Strong written communication and structured thinking. You should be able to turn messy research into a clear learning narrative.
* Genuine interest in teaching and understanding how people learn technical subjects.
* High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort working in an environment where ideas are frequently challenged and improved.



  





**Preferred Background \-** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical ability.
* 0\-3 years of experience in software engineering, technical education, competitive programming, developer content, curriculum design, or a closely related field.
* Prior experience with LeetCode / interview\-style DSA, competitive programming, teaching, mentoring, technical blogging, open\-source work, or building software projects will be a strong advantage.
* Experience creating educational content is useful, but deep technical ability and research quality matter more than prior social\-media experience.



  





**This Role May Be a Great Fit If \-** 



* You enjoy spending an hour understanding why a system behaves a certain way rather than stopping at the first explanation you find.
* You can solve a DSA problem and are equally interested in explaining the thought process that leads to the solution.
* You routinely ask questions such as “why does this work?”, “when would this fail?”, “what changes at scale?”, and “how would I teach this to someone seeing it for the first time?”.
* You would enjoy helping build not just individual videos, but an entire technology\-learning ecosystem around a creator\-led channel.



  





**What Success Looks Like \-** 



* Consistently publishes technically accurate, differentiated, and well\-researched content.
* Video ideas are driven by real learner problems and strong technical insight rather than generic trend\-chasing.
* Learners can move naturally from a YouTube video into a structured LMS path that deepens their understanding and gives them meaningful practice.
* Research, curriculum, and content systems become repeatable enough for to scale without reducing quality.



  





**Why Join Us ?** 



* Help build a technology education brand from an early stage and directly influence what and how thousands of engineers learn.
* Work across content, engineering, research, and learning design rather than being restricted to a conventional content role.
* Get significant ownership over research, curriculum, and new learning formats.
* Work on topics across DSA, Software Engineering, System Design, and AI Engineering while continuously deepening your own technical understanding.

title: Manager, Technical Training
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 Manager – Technical Training
   

  

 Qualys is changing the market by delivering a SaaS platform that solves the most difficult challenges faced by security and IT operations teams, regardless of an organization's size or complexity. Come work for the only company with a closed\-loop solution that can detect and block sophisticated threats and patch the underlying vulnerabilities being targeted by cyber attackers – all from one agent and one platform.
   

  

 We seek a technical manager who will lead the Qualys Technical Training team. The Qualys Technical Training team oversees and manages the training process for Qualys customers. As the manager of the Training team, you will manage a team of instructors who teach and build content for Qualys and ensure the training we build aligns with customer goals and values.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Overseeing and managing the customer, partner, and internal training process.
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders like product management, support, and engineering to update content.
* Overseeing the team and the content built for our security conferences.
* Understanding customer context, overseeing goals, and providing product demos.
* Educating customers and working with the team to optimize their product setup for the quickest path to success.
* Driving speedy content production.
* Accommodating training requests from Sales.
* Providing feedback from customers to our instructors for continual improvement.
* Improving product adoption and customer retention and helping foster positive customer relationships that create a loyal customer base.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Minimum 4\-5 years of experience in leading a team in customer technical training, enablement, customer service and support, customer success, or similar experience.
* Candidate must have a technical background in cybersecurity, networking, or related technology.
* Experience working on a technical team, such as Technical Support, Enablement, and Customer Success.
* Experience with the Qualys platform as a practitioner, technical seller, sales engineer, subject matter expert, etc.
* Solid understanding and hands\-on experience with continuous threat exposure management (CTEM), asset management, patching, vulnerability/risk management, policy compliance, and configuration management, cloud and application security, and/or threat detection.
* Ability to design learning plans that align with customer objectives.
* Strong analytical and goal\-oriented mindset backed by solid project management skills.
* Experience with content development. A major portion of this role includes managing a team that creates self\-paced and instructor\-led content.
* Working knowledge of popular public cloud services infrastructure offerings such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.
* Prior experience in personally engaging with Enterprise customers.
* Strong communicator – written, verbal, and presentation.
* Excellent emotional intelligence, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

title: Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation)
description:
**Job Title: Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation)**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Location Type: Hybrid**
**Website: https://www.wmfts.com/en/**
**Group: https://www.spiraxgroup.com/**
 Watson\-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions is part of Spirax Group, a FTSE100 and FTSE4Good multi\-national industrial engineering Group with expertise in the control and management of steam, electric thermal solutions, peristaltic pumping and associated fluid technologies.
   

  

 When you join us, you will be integrated into a cooperative and encouraging team, participate in challenging yet critical work, and experience ongoing growth opportunities to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website to learn more.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation) to join our dynamic team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Project quotation and costing**
 You will prepare accurate quotations for engineered systems, equipment packages and project\-based enquiries.
   

  

 You will review customer specifications, drawings, P\&IDs, Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to determine the most suitable technical solution.
   

  

 You will prepare detailed cost estimates covering equipment, accessories, fabrication, testing, commissioning and logistics.
   

  

 You will work closely with our parent manufacturing factories to obtain pricing, lead times and technical clarifications.
   

  

 You will ensure quotations comply with pricing guidelines, margin expectations and approval processes.
   

  

**Technical support**
 You will provide pre\-sales technical support to Sales teams and Sector Managers throughout the quotation process.
   

  

 You will recommend technical solutions based on customer applications, process requirements and operating conditions.
   

  

 You will prepare technical bid documentation, compliance statements and product submissions.
   

  

 You will support customer discussions, both virtually and onsite where required, to clarify technical requirements and project scope.
   

  

**Project scoping and risk assessment**
 You will review customer requirements to establish project scope, assumptions and exclusions.
   

  

 You will assess technical, commercial and operational risks that may impact project delivery.
   

  

 You will highlight significant risks and recommend appropriate mitigation or escalation where required.
   

  

**Cross\-functional collaboration**
 You will collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support and local assembly teams to establish realistic manufacturing and delivery timelines.
   

  

 You will work with Product Specialists and Engineering teams on customised or non\-standard solutions.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary liaison with our parent manufacturing factories for technical enquiries, product selection and quotation support.
   

  

**Documentation and process management**
 You will ensure quotations comply with internal procedures, document control requirements and ISO 9001 quality standards.
   

  

 You will maintain quotation records, pricing information and standard quotation templates.
   

  

 You will monitor quotation progress, conversion rates and win/loss trends to support business reporting and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will contribute to improving quotation processes, templates, tools and costing methodologies.
   

  

**Project handover**
 You will prepare complete project handover documentation for confirmed orders, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), configurations, drawings, schedules and commercial information.
   

  

 You will work with internal stakeholders to support a smooth transition from quotation to order fulfilment and project execution.
   

  

**Continuous improvement**
 You will contribute to process improvement initiatives and support cross\-functional projects as required.
   

  

**Who you’ll be working with
   

  

 Internal stakeholders**
 You will work closely with Sales teams and Sector Managers to develop technical and commercially competitive proposals.
   

  

 You will collaborate with fellow Application Engineers within the regional Project Quotation Team.
   

  

 You will partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support, Product Specialists and local assembly teams to ensure successful project outcomes.
   

  

 You will liaise with our parent manufacturing factories on technical solutions, pricing and delivery commitments.
   

  

**External stakeholders**
 You will communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements, specifications and project scope throughout the quotation process.
   

  

**Skills \& Experience**
* 3\-5 years of experience preparing technical quotations, tenders or engineered proposals.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, datasheets and customer specifications.
* Sound understanding of mechanical or process engineering principles, including flow, pressure, materials and equipment selection.
* Experience with engineered equipment, rotating machinery, pumps, process systems or instrumentation will be an advantage.
* Experience using ERP, CRM or quotation management systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Maintain and manage databases related to quotations, orders, and project activities to ensure data accuracy and accessibility.
* Support vendor development activities for customized products such as SS trolleys, VFDs, motor covers, and other customer\-specific requirements.
* Calculate and analyse order margins during both pre\-order and post\-order stages to support commercial decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation initiatives using AI and digital tools to streamline existing processes, improve efficiency, and enhance overall productivity.
* Identify process gaps, analyse information, and proactively provide solutions to improve operational effectiveness and customer responsiveness.


**Qualifications**
* A degree or diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline is preferred. Equivalent practical experience in technical quotation, application engineering or project engineering will also be considered.
* Communication
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to communicate technical information clearly with customers and internal stakeholders.


**Personal attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering accurate and timely work.
* A structured and organised approach with strong commercial awareness.
* Confidence working collaboratively across multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* A proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and commitment to delivering high\-quality outcomes.


**At Watson\-Marlow, we believe in taking care of our colleagues. We offer a generous benefits package, including:**
* A competitive salary
* Flexible working arrangements
* A generous holiday allowance
* Three days’ paid volunteering leave
* Life assurance
* Additional support and benefits through our Everyone is Included Group Inclusion Plan


**Everyone is Included at Spirax Group**
 We are passionate about creating inclusive and equitable working cultures where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. For us, that means supportive teams and strong relationships where everyone’s contribution is valued \- across social and cultural backgrounds, ethnicities, ages, genders, gender identities, abilities, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, and everything else that makes us human and unique.
   

  

 We want everyone to be able to make their difference here, so we will always consider requests for flexible working.

 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

 If you require accommodations during the application process, please let us know.
   

  

**Company Overview**
 At Watson\-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions, part of Spirax Group, we are driven by innovation and are dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is empowered to make a difference. As a world leader in manufacturing peristaltic pumps and associated fluid path technologies for the life sciences and process industries, we offer a wide range of products, including tubing, specialised filling systems and products for single\-use applications.

Our technologies play an essential role in critical industrial processes and industrial equipment across industries as diverse as Food \& Beverage, Pharmaceutical \& Biotechnology, Power Generation, Semiconductors and Healthcare.
